-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.InvWatchBatch` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.batchStepL (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (D : List Loc) (Bm : GMap Loc
    mvcc.EventBatch) : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch :=
  List.foldl
    (fun Bm w =>
      if mvcc.minRevLe ST ev w = true then <[w := mvcc.ebAdd ((Bm !! w).getD mvcc.EventBatch.empty) ev]>Bm else Bm)
    Bm D

def mvcc.ownEventBatch (eb : Loc) (B : mvcc.EventBatch) (q : Qp := 1) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ s ps,
      typedPointsto eb { evs' := s, revs' := B.revs, moreRev' := B.moreRev } (DFrac.own q) ∗
        ownSlice s ps (DFrac.own q) ∗
          ownSliceCap Loc s (DFrac.own q) ∗
            ⌜ps.length = B.evs.length⌝ ∗ [∗list] x ∈ ps.zip B.evs, mvcc.evOwn x.fst x.snd q)

def mvcc.evIs (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p q st uf sc,
      ⌜e ≠ null ∧ p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        typedPointsto e
            { state' := st, Type' := mvcc.evType ev, Kv' := p, PrevKv' := q, unknownFields' := uf, sizeCache' := sc }
            DFrac.discard ∗
          mvcc.kvPtrFixed p ev.kv ∗
            match ev.prevKv with
            | none => ⌜q = null⌝
            | some pk => mvcc.kvPtrFixed q pk)

theorem mvcc.kvPtrFixed_persistent (p : Loc) (kv : EtcdKv) : Persistent (mvcc.kvPtrFixed p kv)

def mvcc.memberBatch (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) (evs : List mvcc.EvM) : Option
    mvcc.EventBatch :=
  List.foldl
    (fun ob ev =>
      if (r.covers ev.kv.key && decide (sint.Z st.minRev ≤ sint.Z ev.kv.modRev)) = true then
        some (mvcc.ebAdd (ob.getD mvcc.EventBatch.empty) ev)
      else ob)
    none evs

def mvcc.batchOf (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (evs : List mvcc.EvM)
    : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch :=
  {
    lookup := fun w =>
      match W !! w, ST !! w with
      | some r, some st => mvcc.memberBatch r st evs
      | x, x_1 => none,
    finite := ⋯ }

def mvcc.chooseCmp (Cm : GMap Loc Unit) (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt :=
  mvcc.gmapMapK
    (fun w st =>
      if (Cm !! w).isSome = true then
        { minRev := st.minRev, victim := st.victim, compacted := true, restore := st.restore, ch := st.ch }
      else st)
    ST

def mvcc.minRevLe (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (w : Loc) : Bool :=
  match ST !! w with
  | some st => decide (sint.Z st.minRev ≤ sint.Z ev.kv.modRev)
  | none => false

theorem mvcc.kv_fields (l : Loc) (v : go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.KeyValue) (dq : DFrac) :
    typedPointsto l v dq ⊢ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.KeyValue
    go!"Key" l) v.Key' dq ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.KeyValue
    go!"ModRevision" l) v.ModRevision' dq

def mvcc.gmapMapK {K V V' : Type} (f : K → V → V') (m : GMap K V) : GMap K V' :=
  { lookup := fun k => Option.map (f k) (m !! k), finite := ⋯ }

theorem mvcc.rstClear_minRev (curRev : w64) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) : (mvcc.rstClear curRev st).minRev
    = st.minRev

theorem mvcc.evRd_modRev (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : mvcc.evRd e ev ⊢ ∃ p, typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event go!"Kv" e) p DFrac.discard ∗ typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.KeyValue go!"ModRevision" p) ev.kv.modRev
    DFrac.discard

theorem mvcc.batchStepL_lookup (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (D : List Loc) (Bm :
    GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) (hnd : D.Nodup) (w : Loc) : mvcc.batchStepL ST ev D Bm !! w = if w ∈ D
    ∧ mvcc.minRevLe ST ev w = true then some (mvcc.ebAdd ((Bm !! w).getD mvcc.EventBatch.empty) ev)
    else Bm !! w

theorem mvcc.gmapMapK_lookup {K V V' : Type} (f : K → V → V') (m : GMap K V) (k : K) : mvcc.gmapMapK
    f m !! k = Option.map (f k) (m !! k)

theorem mvcc.minRevL_chooseRst (curRev : w64) (D : GMap Loc Unit) (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (L
    : List Loc) : mvcc.minRevL (mvcc.chooseRst curRev D ST) L = mvcc.minRevL ST L

structure mvcc.EventBatch : Type where
  evs : List mvcc.EvM
  revs : w64
  moreRev : w64

theorem mvcc.bigSepM_gmapMapK {V V' : Type} (f : Loc → V → V') (m : GMap Loc V) (Φ : Loc → V' →
    IProp GF) : ([∗map] k ↦ y ∈ mvcc.gmapMapK f m, Φ k y) ⊣⊢ [∗map] k ↦ y ∈ m, Φ k (f k y)

theorem mvcc.rstClear_victim (curRev : w64) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) : (mvcc.rstClear curRev st).victim
    = st.victim

def mvcc.ownWatcherBatch (wb : GoMap) (Bm : GMap Loc mvcc.EventBatch) (q : Qp := 1) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ PB,
      ownMap wb (DFrac.own q) (GMap.fmap Prod.fst PB) ∗
        ⌜Bm = GMap.fmap Prod.snd PB⌝ ∗ [∗map] p ∈ PB, iprop(⌜p.fst ≠ null⌝ ∗ mvcc.ownEventBatch p.fst p.snd q))

def mvcc.ebAdd (eb : mvcc.EventBatch) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : mvcc.EventBatch :=
  if sint.Z mvcc.watchBatchMaxRevsV < sint.Z eb.revs then eb
  else
    match eb.evs.getLast? with
    | none => { evs := [ev], revs := W64 1, moreRev := eb.moreRev }
    | some last =>
      if sint.Z last.kv.modRev < sint.Z ev.kv.modRev then
        if sint.Z mvcc.watchBatchMaxRevsV < sint.Z (eb.revs + W64 1) then
          { evs := eb.evs, revs := eb.revs + W64 1, moreRev := ev.kv.modRev }
        else { evs := eb.evs ++ [ev], revs := eb.revs + W64 1, moreRev := eb.moreRev }
      else { evs := eb.evs ++ [ev], revs := eb.revs, moreRev := eb.moreRev }

theorem mvcc.minRevL_eq (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (S : GMap Loc Unit) (D : List Loc) (hnd :
    D.Nodup) (hD : ∀ (w : Loc), w ∈ D ↔ (S !! w).isSome = true) : mvcc.minRevL ST D = mvcc.minRevOf
    ST S

theorem mvcc.batchOf_nil (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) :
    mvcc.batchOf W ST [] = ∅

theorem mvcc.rstClear_compacted (curRev : w64) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) : (mvcc.rstClear curRev
    st).compacted = st.compacted

theorem mvcc.batchOf_lookup (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (evs :
    List mvcc.EvM) (w : Loc) : mvcc.batchOf W ST evs !! w = match W !! w, ST !! w with | some r,
    some st => mvcc.memberBatch r st evs | x, x_1 => none

def mvcc.takeMembers (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (keys : List Loc) (n : Nat) : GMap Loc
    mvcc.WatchRange :=
  GMap.filter (fun k x => decide (k ∈ List.take n keys)) W

def mvcc.minRevL (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (D : List Loc) : Int :=
  List.foldl (mvcc.minRevStep ST) (2 ^ 63 - 1) D

theorem mvcc.evIs_persistent (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : Persistent (mvcc.evIs e ev)

def mvcc.evPk (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (q : Qp := 1) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pq,
      typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event go!"PrevKv" e) pq
          (DFrac.own q) ∗
        mvcc.prevKvIs pq ev.prevKv)

theorem mvcc.minRevL_snoc (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (D : List Loc) (w : Loc) : mvcc.minRevL ST
    (D ++ [w]) = mvcc.minRevStep ST (mvcc.minRevL ST D) w

theorem mvcc.takeMembers_succ (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (keys : List Loc) (n : Nat) (key : Loc)
    (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (hkey : keys[n]? = some key) (hnd : keys.Nodup) (hW : W !! key = some r) :
    mvcc.takeMembers W keys (n + 1) = <[key := r]>(mvcc.takeMembers W keys n) ∧ mvcc.takeMembers W
    keys n !! key = none

theorem mvcc.prevKvIs_persistent (q : Loc) (pk : Option EtcdKv) : Persistent (mvcc.prevKvIs q pk)

def mvcc.rstClear (curRev : w64) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) : mvcc.WatcherSt :=
  if sint.Z curRev < sint.Z st.minRev then
    { minRev := st.minRev, victim := st.victim, compacted := st.compacted, restore := false, ch := st.ch }
  else st

theorem mvcc.takeMembers_zero (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (keys : List Loc) : mvcc.takeMembers W
    keys 0 = ∅

theorem mvcc.evOwn_persist (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (q : Qp) : mvcc.evOwn e ev q ⊢ |==> mvcc.evIs e
    ev

theorem mvcc.event_fields (l : Loc) (v : go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event) (dq : DFrac) :
    typedPointsto l v dq ⊢ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event
    go!"Type" l) v.Type' dq ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event
    go!"Kv" l) v.Kv' dq ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event
    go!"PrevKv" l) v.PrevKv' dq

theorem mvcc.bigSepL_filter_drop {A : Type} (p : A → Bool) (Φ : A → IProp GF) (l : List A) :
    ([∗list] x ∈ l, Φ x) ⊢ [∗list] x ∈ List.filter p l, Φ x

def mvcc.watchBatchMaxRevsV : w64 :=
  W64 1000

theorem mvcc.takeMembers_subseteq (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (keys : List Loc) (n : Nat) :
    mvcc.takeMembers W keys n ⊆ W

theorem mvcc.batchOf_snoc (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (evs : List
    mvcc.EvM) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (D : List Loc) (hnd : D.Nodup) (hD : ∀ (w : Loc), w ∈ D ↔
    ((mvcc.membersBy W fun x => x.covers ev.kv.key) !! w).isSome = true) : mvcc.batchStepL ST ev D
    (mvcc.batchOf W ST evs) = mvcc.batchOf W ST (evs ++ [ev])

def mvcc.EventBatch.empty : mvcc.EventBatch :=
  { evs := [], revs := W64 0, moreRev := W64 0 }

def mvcc.minRevStep (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (m : Int) (w : Loc) : Int :=
  match ST !! w with
  | some st => min m (sint.Z st.minRev)
  | none => m

def mvcc.evRd (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p st uf sc,
      ⌜e ≠ null ∧ p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event go!"state" e) st
            DFrac.discard ∗
          typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event go!"Type" e)
              (mvcc.evType ev) DFrac.discard ∗
            typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event go!"Kv" e) p DFrac.discard ∗
              typedPointsto
                  (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event
                    go!"unknownFields" e)
                  uf DFrac.discard ∗
                typedPointsto
                    (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.Event
                      go!"sizeCache" e)
                    sc DFrac.discard ∗
                  mvcc.kvPtrFixed p ev.kv)

theorem mvcc.evOwns_split (l : List (Loc × mvcc.EvM)) (q : Qp) : ([∗list] x ∈ l, mvcc.evOwn x.fst
    x.snd q) ⊣⊢ ([∗list] x ∈ l, mvcc.evRd x.fst x.snd) ∗ [∗list] x ∈ l, mvcc.evPk x.fst x.snd q

def mvcc.evOwn (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (q : Qp := 1) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.evRd e ev ∗ mvcc.evPk e ev q)

theorem mvcc.evIs_evRd (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : mvcc.evIs e ev ⊢ mvcc.evRd e ev

def mvcc.evType (ev : mvcc.EvM) : w32 :=
  if ev.del = true then W32 1 else W32 0

theorem mvcc.minRevOf_chooseRst (curRev : w64) (D S : GMap Loc Unit) (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt)
    : mvcc.minRevOf (mvcc.chooseRst curRev D ST) S = mvcc.minRevOf ST S

theorem mvcc.evOwn_rd (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (q : Qp) : mvcc.evOwn e ev q ⊢ mvcc.evOwn e ev q ∗
    mvcc.evRd e ev

theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroup_watchers (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) :
    mvcc.ownWatcherGroup wg W ⊢ ∃ v, typedPointsto wg v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ mvcc.ownWatcherSet
    v.watchers' W.domSet ∗ (typedPointsto wg v (DFrac.own 1) -∗ mvcc.ownWatcherSet v.watchers'
    W.domSet -∗ mvcc.ownWatcherGroup wg W)

def mvcc.prevKvIs (q : Loc) (pk : Option EtcdKv) : IProp GF :=
  match pk with
  | none => iprop(⌜q = null⌝)
  | some k => mvcc.kvPtrFixed q k

structure mvcc.EvM : Type where
  del : Bool
  kv : EtcdKv
  prevKv : Option EtcdKv

def mvcc.minRevOf (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (S : GMap Loc Unit) : Int :=
  mvcc.minRevL ST S.domList

theorem mvcc.rstClear_ch (curRev : w64) (st : mvcc.WatcherSt) : (mvcc.rstClear curRev st).ch = st.ch

theorem mvcc.evRd_persistent (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) : Persistent (mvcc.evRd e ev)

def mvcc.notBehind (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (c : w64) (w : Loc) : Bool :=
  match ST !! w with
  | some st => decide (sint.Z c ≤ sint.Z st.minRev)
  | none => true

theorem mvcc.evOwn_intro (e p q : Loc) (st : google_golang_org.protobuf.internal.impl.MessageState)
    (uf : GoSlice) (sc : w32) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (hp : p ≠ null) : typedPointsto e { state' := st,
    Type' := mvcc.evType ev, Kv' := p, PrevKv' := q, unknownFields' := uf, sizeCache' := sc }
    (DFrac.own 1) ∗ mvcc.kvPtrFixed p ev.kv ∗ mvcc.prevKvIs q ev.prevKv ⊢ |==> mvcc.evOwn e ev

def mvcc.chooseRst (curRev : w64) (D : GMap Loc Unit) (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) : GMap Loc
    mvcc.WatcherSt :=
  mvcc.gmapMapK (fun w st => if (D !! w).isSome = true then mvcc.rstClear curRev st else st) ST

def mvcc.ownStates (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) : IProp GF :=
  [∗map] w ↦ st ∈ ST, mvcc.watcherOwn w st

theorem mvcc.evOwns_persist (l : List (Loc × mvcc.EvM)) (q : Qp) : ([∗list] x ∈ l, mvcc.evOwn x.fst
    x.snd q) ⊢ |==> [∗list] x ∈ l, mvcc.evIs x.fst x.snd

def mvcc.kvPtrFixed (p : Loc) (kv : EtcdKv) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ks vs st uf sc,
      ownSlice ks kv.key DFrac.discard ∗
        ownSlice vs kv.value DFrac.discard ∗
          typedPointsto p
            { state' := st, Key' := ks, CreateRevision' := kv.createRev, ModRevision' := kv.modRev,
              Version' := kv.version, Value' := vs, Lease' := kv.lease, unknownFields' := uf, sizeCache' := sc }
            DFrac.discard)
